summary: Iteration 24 — Production-readiness E2E for NivX Machines auth + bookmarks + watchlist + RBAC + feed collectors. 17/17 backend pytest tests passed. Frontend E2E covering signup → avatar dropdown → bookmark toggle → /me → IOC watchlist → logout all passed. ThreatBox lists 16/16 seeded actors; APT41 shows Related Incidents from actor_slug FK. Live-feed pagination caps at 50/200/500 correctly. IOC sync-status returns urlhaus/threatfox/cins entries. RBAC: role='user' JWT is blocked with 403 from POST /api/threats. No critical or minor issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: Signup rate-limit (5/IP/hr) is enforced via MongoDB db.signup_attempts with no TTL index — long-term will grow unbounded. Consider adding a TTL index on created_at (e.g. 3600s * 24) or periodic cleanup.
backend/server.py is now 5229 lines — well above the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into routers (auth, me, threats, iocs, healthbot, cyberlab) before further growth.

Backward-compat: /actors/lockbit renders the profile at /actors/lockbit (does NOT redirect to /threatbox/lockbit as the spec implies). API /api/actors/:slug returns 200 — both paths coexist which is acceptable but inconsistent with the stated 'redirect' behaviour. Confirm intent.
test_credentials: admin@nivxmachines.com / NivX@Admin2025 ; new user created dynamically each run (e.g. e2e_<uuid>@example.com / TestPass1234)
seed_data_creation: Cleared db.signup_attempts before running tests to bypass 5/IP/hour rate limit. Test-created users and bookmarks/watchlist entries remain in Mongo but are prefixed with e2e_/test_iter24_ so easy to clean up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Correct API routes: POST/DELETE /api/me/bookmarks/threatbox/{slug} (NOT /api/me/bookmarks). Watchlist: POST/GET /api/me/watchlist, DELETE /api/me/watchlist/{value}. Actors index: GET /api/actors (list) and GET /api/actors/{slug}. Sign-up rate-limited to 5/IP/hr — if running the suite locally, clear db.signup_attempts first: `await db.signup_attempts.delete_many({})`. Navbar avatar data-testid = 'nav-user-avatar'; login link data-testid = 'nav-login-btn'; more menu = 'nav-more-menu'. Weak password → 422, duplicate email → 409, watchlist dup → 409, watchlist invalid → 422.
